decision_conditions:
The facing materials used in the development to which this permission relates shall match those of the existing building(s) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.<div>

</div>

<p>No windows or doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p>

Notwithstanding the approved plans, details of secure and covered parking for a minimum of 13no. cycle parking spaces are to be submitted and approved by the Council prior to occupation of the development. The cycle parking shall be made available prior to the first occupation of the development and shall be retained thereafter.&nbsp;
Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority.

The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the approved drawing. The developer and/or their successors in title shall take all reasonable steps to ensure that all refuse and recyclable materials associated with the development are either stored within these facilities or internally within the building(s) on the application site, and that no refuse or recycling material is stored or placed for collection on the public highway except on the day of collection.<div>

</div>

Prior to occupation of the development, a parking design and management plan shall be submitted and approved by the Council. The design and management plan shall include (but not be limited to) details relating to how car parking will be allocated and managed post-development, how additional disabled parking will be provided (if required in accordance with London Plan requirements), and details of the provision of electric vehicle charging points. The parking management plan shall be implemented in accordance with the details as so agreed prior to the first occupation of the development and adhered to thereafter.

<p style="padding: 0.75pt;">Notwithstanding the provisions of Condition A.2(3) of Class A, Part 20 of the GPDO, prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved, a Construction Logistics Plan shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The Construction Logistics Plan shall provide for:</p><ol><li style="">Construction vehicles numbers, type, routing;</li><li style="">Access arrangements to the site;</li><li style="">Construction &amp; Storage compounds (including areas designated for car parking, loading/unloading and turning areas;</li><li style="">Cleaning of site entrances, site tracks and the adjacent public highway;</li><li style="">Timing of construction activities (including delivery times and removal of waste) and to avoid school pick up/drop off times;</li><li style="">Post construction restoration/reinstatement of the working areas and temporary access to the public highway;</li><li style="">Where works cannot be contained wholly within the site a plan should be submitted showing the site layout on the highway including extent of hoarding, pedestrian routes and remaining road width for vehicle movements;</li><li style="">Detailed timeline for the phases and implementation of the development;</li><li style="">Measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during;</li><li style="">&nbsp;Scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works.</li></ol><p style="margin-left: 12.7pt; padding: 0.75pt;">The construction works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p style="margin-left: 12.7pt; padding: 0.75pt;"><br></p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Existing Basement and First Floor Plan (PR-29-33-EX.01); Existing Second and Third Floors (PR-29-33-EX.02); Existing Roof Plan(PR-29-33-EX.03);&nbsp; Existing Front and Side Elevations (PR-29-33-EX.04); Existing Sections (PR-29-33-EX.05); Proposed Basement and Proposed First Floor Plans (PR-29-33-PR-01); Proposed Second and Third Floors (PR-29-33-PR-02); Proposed Fourth and Fifth Floors (PR-29-33-PR-03); Proposed Roof Plan (PR-29-33-PR-04); Proposed Front and Side Elevations (PR-29-33-PR.05); Proposed Sections (PR-29-33-PR-06 Rev A); Planning Statement (Prepared by AJ Plans, dated 10 November 2025); Daylight and Sunlight Report (Within Development); &nbsp;Prepared by Right of Light Consulting, dated 16 April 2021; Daylight and Sunlight Report (Neighbouring Properties) (Prepared by Right of Light Consulting, dated 16 April 2021); Location Plan.<div>

</div>
description: Additional two storeys (height 6.3 m) of development containing 12 flats on an existing detached block of flats - maximum overall height 18m (Prior approval of transport and highways impacts; air traffic and defence asset impacts; contamination risks; flooding risks; the external appearance of the building; the provision of adequate natural light in all habitable rooms of the new dwellinghouses; impact on the amenity of the existing building and neighbouring premises and impact on a protected view)
